## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky21

- Add `--incompatible_use_native_posix_test_wrapper`, disabled by default. When enabled, Linux and macOS tests use a native C++ test wrapper instead of `test-setup.sh` on supported execution platforms. Tests with a nondefault test execution group or an execution platform without an operating-system constraint continue to use `test-setup.sh`; Windows retains its existing native wrapper. Based on [bazelbuild/bazel#30837](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/30837).
- Share ZIP and undeclared-output manifest support between the POSIX and Windows native wrappers. With the flag disabled, test execution still uses the existing wrapper selection.

### Validation

`TestActionBuilderTest`, `tw_test`, and the two new `bazel_test_test` integration cases passed. A macOS arm64 source build passed smoke tests with the flag disabled and enabled, including undeclared-output ZIP handling and verification of the selected test wrapper.

### Release publication

This release is immutable and includes Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64, with SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations.
